video.title: Working local product demonstration
video.description: One uncut recording of the private Research Lab: configure a strategy, run two real backtests on synthetic market data, read the quality check, performance, chart and trades, then compare the variants.

transcript.text: The Research Lab runs the real backtesting engine, here on synthetic market data.
Choose a strategy, a pair, an interval and a range.
Set parameters. Fees, slippage, capital and risk follow one explicit policy.
Run a historical backtest. Each run is isolated in its own container.
The quality check reads return after costs, drawdown, profit factor and sample size.
Performance after fees, slippage and funding, with buy and hold as a reference.
Candles and trades exactly as the run saw them.
The equity curve and every closed trade.
Test a second parameter variant on the same data.
Compare variants: return, drawdown, profit factor and equity, side by side.
The newest 12 months stay held out for a separate recent-period check.
